A1.justification: Both PDFs present JAFAR: Jack up Any Feature at Any Resolution. All 21 pages, including Appendices A–F, are readable and support reliable comparison of text, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original downstream-task experiments, ablations, qualitative analyses, and computational measurements in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including segmentation, depth estimation, CAM evaluation, robustness analyses, and runtime/memory measurements.

M1.justification: The cross-attention architecture, SFT modulation, RoPE, training objective, and inference procedure are identical. The distillation variant in Appendix C.2 is also unchanged.

E1.justification: ImageNet, COCO/COCO-Stuff, VOC, ADE20K, Cityscapes, and nuScenes coverage is unchanged, as are the evaluated downstream tasks and appendix scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding experiments, including the official-checkpoint FeatUp and LiFT comparisons and the LoftUp comparison in Appendix C.

E3.justification: Training budgets, backbones, resolutions, probing procedures, metrics, and evaluation samples are unchanged. Appendix A.1 retains the same 2,000-image CAM evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Both versions contain identical key-construction and attention-head ablations, RoPE ablations, upsampling-scale robustness tests, attention visualizations, and distillation analyses.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, both retain JAFAR's 84.44 VOC mIoU in Table 1 and 73.3 ADCC in Table 2.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(10), including attention, modulation, the training loss, and appendix metric definitions, are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about arbitrary-resolution feature upsampling, task-agnostic training, generalization across scales, and downstream performance.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Both retain the separate-per-backbone training requirement and Appendix F's computational and memory limitations for large key sets.

D1.justification: Section 6 newly discloses access to IDRIS HPC resources through GENCI allocation 2025-AD011014763R1. This adds computing-resource provenance; the reported A100 setup, implementation settings, and code/data links remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 58 cited works and research-positioning discussions are retained. Bibliography entries move across pages without changes to their content.

P1.justification: Section 6 gains one computing-resource acknowledgment sentence, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added acknowledgment causes limited bibliography reflow across pages 10–13. All 14 tables and nine figures retain their design and placement, including those in the appendices.

improvement.justification: v3 adds computing-resource attribution and updates the version stamp, with minor bibliography reflow. The scientific content, evidence, explanations, and practical reproducibility settings are unchanged, so these edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
